s05191.summary: In a blackout Denise clutches a frozen turkey while Gail mocks her.
Neighbour Raj walks in with a head torch and casserole uninvited.
A knocked candle sets menus alight; Raj douses it with lasagne.
In the smoke, Denise mourns the lasagne and Raj calls it sacrifice.
The sisters-in-law sit together, worrying about a call about Christmas.
The power returns and the forgotten turkey thuds to the floor.

s05192.summary: Protesters chain the Mining Bureau doors as Sheriff Pike stands guard.
Pike gives the crowd ten seconds to break it up.
Juniper retorts about water; Corbin demands arrests; Sam dares them.
Shoving erupts into a brawl between Juniper and Corbin.
Pike fires into the air and everyone freezes.
Sam slackens the chain, Juniper laughs bloodily, and the crowd scatters.
Sam sits in the dirt and notes there's still no rain.

s05193.summary: At a climate sit-in, Terrence waits on a bench with a blank sign.
Gordon sits beside him; they call the protest good cover.
Terrence shows a floor plan taped behind his sign.
Terrence says Gordon's contractor cousin lied about the sensor.
Gordon shares his wife's cardamom tea; they trade dry quips.
They muse that the protesters believe, while they believe in a safe.
Feeding the dog, Gordon sets nine o'clock during the mayor's dinner.
Terrence silently regards the protesters and his blank sign.
They assign the stairwell and the loud elevator.
Both listen longer than planned as drowned towns are named.
Gordon pats his shoulder, warns him not to be late, and leaves.
Terrence raises his blank sign with the crowd.

s05194.summary: A family idles on their late father's boat with a stranger aboard.
Nell asks who the stranger is; he says he's here for nets.
Nell insists they're not selling; Rosalind says she only said if.
Owen introduces himself and reveals Dad hid a deed.
In tense silence Nell asks where; Owen names the forward locker.
The family exchange looks and agree to check later.

s05195_0.summary: Mo slips into the dark gym and unpacks a burglary kit.
A text gives four minutes; Mo grumbles about Kip and Kim's names.
Mo hides from the humming janitor, who wanders off on a call.
Mo wrestles the trophy case lock and lifts Big Dave's dumbbell.
A text warns a big bearded man is outside: Big Dave.
Mo bags the trophy and picks the only route, past the pool.
A treadmill roars on; Mo hides as the janitor shuts it off.
Mo creeps past a woman swimming laps in the dark.
The fire door opens silently; Kim disabled the alarm.

s05195_1.summary: Mo jumps into an idling van that pulls away as the sign dies.

s05197.summary: On a crab boat, Leon teases the woman hunting for signal.
Her mum calls, grilling her about the fisherman; she dodges.
Leo pipes up and the Leo-Leon name confusion unfolds.
Hannah introduces herself and teases Leon for rushing her aboard.
She throws a glove at Leo and keeps her hand on Leon's arm.

s05198_0.summary: A beige fertility clinic waiting room with Mara and distracted Brad.
Brett bursts in with a bouquet calling Mara honey.
Brenda deadpans about husbands; Mara explains Brett is Brad's brother.
Dr. Vance calls Mara and cheerfully invites both men.
Brenda allows one husband; Mara insists on going alone.
Brad demands why Brett came; Brenda agrees he looks fragile.
A text warns about Brett; Brad pales and calls it spam.
The brothers grapple for the phone; the bouquet lands in the tank.

s05198_1.summary: On the exam table, Mara spots a vial labeled Feldman.
Mara demands which Feldman; Vance smoothly deflects.
The lights flicker and Brenda quietly locks the front door.
Brad and Brett burst in with overlapping, contradictory confessions.
Vance slips a hand to a hidden weapon and urges calm.
Brenda announces the two o'clock is the police.
Vance's smile drops; Brett raises the bouquet and asks to leave.

s05199.summary: In a blackout Kit and Jo bring a dying laptop to the kitchen.
Slack shows coaches waiting on Kit's lineup.
Jo reminds Kit he promised to print it; he blames the printer.
Jo sketches plays by phone light, debating the left wing.
Kit fails with the marker; Jo bites it into working.
At two percent they both lunge and send a lineup.
They laugh at the wrong lineup as the power returns: peas for dinner.
